result.title: Learning What to Change: State-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Educational Agents
result.summary: Persistent tutoring agents do more than answer questions: they manage course files, practice records, and learner profiles that govern future lessons. In such stateful settings, knowing what to teach does not guarantee knowing what to change. We identify a pervasive failure mode, content-state decoupling, where agents deliver pedagogically sound responses while silently corrupting workspace state through unwarranted updates, missed prerequisites, or unintended side effects. Text-level judges overlook these state errors, whereas isolated tool-call checks break down because whether a write action is valid depends jointly on the learner request, prior state, and execution order. We propose State-Verified Reinforcement Learning, which supervises online policy optimization directly through verifiable workspace transitions. Within isolated sandboxes that snapshot state around every tool call, a deterministic verifier audits tool effects, workflow ordering, and native auto-sync side effects, pairing graded partial credit with a hard gate that zeroes episode reward upon any critical violation. Whenever no critical violation occurs, an evidence-grounded judge scores actual saved artifacts rather than agent claims. We pair 1,000 verifiable training instances with an independently authored, human-reviewed evaluation benchmark of 60 tasks spanning 11 educational categories and 16 native tools. After online GRPO training, Qwen3.8-27B raises category-weighted strict success on our benchmark from 51.47% to 80.74% (+29.27 points), cutting content-pass-only execution failures from 45.6% to 13.7% and required state-check failures from 63 to 1 across 180 trials. The resulting policy outperforms seven reference baselines by over 20 points while reducing output tokens by 17-39% across seven of eight external benchmarks without regressing on general reasoning or tool use.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出教学智能体在维护课程文件、练习记录与学习者画像时会出现「内容—状态解耦」：回答看似合理却破坏工作区状态；为此提出 State-Verified RL，在快照沙箱中用确定性验证器审计工具调用的效果、顺序与副作用，并以分级部分分加关键违规归零的硬门控配合证据对齐评分器来做在线 GRPO 训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按可验证状态转移而非文本自述给奖励、对关键违规硬门控」的监督设计，可能可供核查用于 LVR 中判断 latent 状态是否真正依据视觉证据更新、抑制无依据的状态改写，但属远域借鉴线索，需人工确认迁移可行性。
